propositions: Environment variable REBAR_DETECTED_BY stamps a detection source (canary|ci|review-bot|agent|human-audit|user-report) on ticket creation; an optional --detected-by CLI flag overrides it, and absence of both leaves the field unset.
Validation normalizes the value via strip+lowercase; empty or whitespace-only is treated as unset; unknown tokens are stamped verbatim without enum enforcement, so create never fails on the value.
process_create projects detected_by present-only into compiled state (mirroring source_* projection), and events without the field reduce byte-identically to pre-change state (additivity proof).
The detected_by field is declared optional in ticket_state.schema.json and registered in the env-var/docs registry so drift gates cover it.
Jira inbound reconciler (apply_inbound_records.py) bypasses create_core and correctly does not capture detected_by, avoiding mis-attribution of the reconciler daemon's own environment.
